name: memhop-knowledge
summary: L3 知识图谱说明书：读取/列出/导入/更新/删除语义图谱，查询节点与子图
trigger: 需要管理或查询 L3 语义知识图谱、结构化知识时；knowledge 知识 l3 图谱 语义 节点 边 hypergraph

resources.name: GetL3
resources.desc: 按 ID 读取一个 L3 知识图谱

resources.name: ListL3
resources.desc: 列出全部 L3 知识图谱；返回图谱摘要（ID/名称/节点边计数）

resources.name: ImportL3
resources.desc: 批量导入 L3 实体/关系；items=待导入节点/边列表、mode=覆盖/合并模式；返回新建/更新/跳过统计
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object"},"description":"待导入节点/边列表"},"mode":{"type":"string","description":"覆盖/合并模式"}},"required":["items","mode"]}

resources.name: UpdateL3
resources.desc: 更新 L3 图谱元信息；name=nil 表示不改名
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"图谱 ID（16 位 hex）"},"name":{"type":"string","description":"新名称（缺省不改名）"}},"required":["id"]}

resources.name: DeleteL3
resources.desc: 删除整个 L3 知识图谱

resources.name: QueryL3Nodes
resources.desc: 按条件查询 L3 节点；q 支持按图谱/标签/关键词过滤

resources.name: QueryL3Subgraph
resources.desc: 从起始节点展开子图；edgeKinds 限定关系类型（causal/semantic/temporal 等），maxDepth 限制展开深度
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"graph_id":{"type":"string","description":"图谱 ID（16 位 hex）"},"start_node_id":{"type":"string","description":"起始节点 ID（16 位 hex）"},"max_depth":{"type":"integer","description":"展开深度限制"},"edge_kinds":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"限定关系类型"}},"required":["graph_id","start_node_id","max_depth"]}

steps.action: 从关键节点展开关联子图
